description: rec_d62ad23ebe5c4e438caa in the Even simulator: live-saved PCM was transcribed correctly by the final Whisper pass, but after the compression stage (WebCodecs Opus via packages/capture/src/opus.ts) the exported WAV is muffled: 98.5% of speech energy below 1 kHz, -85 dB at 4 kHz; Whisper Base, Moonshine and Silero all fail on it. Playback, reprocessing and voice clips from saved audio would be affected. Reproduce with an encode/decode round trip of jfk.wav in WebKitGTK and compare spectra; check sample rates reported by AudioDecoder/AudioData and the f32-planar copy.
title: Saved audio is corrupted by the Opus round trip in WebKitGTK
